Subject: MAP: sequencing & close runway for Summit Health (MSA/DPA/order form)

Hi Elena / Summit procurement team —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Attaching a first-draft mutual action plan (MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short list of proposed milestone owners/timelines so we can lock the runway to signature and pilot start. High-level objectives: get MSA and DPA agreed in parallel with order form so we can start the 30-day pilot the week of 2026-10-05.

Proposed milestones (summary):
- 2026-08-24: Summit returns priority/optional redlines to the MSA and DPA (if possible) — owner: Summit legal
- 2026-08-27: Redwood legal provides consolidated redline and short comment matrix — owner: Karthik (Redwood Legal)
- 2026-09-03: Commercial SLA + order form pricing finalized — owner: Alex / Vanessa
- 2026-09-10: Procurement sign-off & PO submission or purchase order window — owner: Summit procurement
- 2026-09-20: DocuSign execution (MSA + Order Form), DPA executed or appended — owner: operations/legal
- 2026-10-05: Pilot environment provisioned and test plan execution begins — owner: CS/Engineering

Key asks from Summit:
1) Can you confirm a realistic target for returning redlines on the MSA/DPA? If 8/24 is tight, tell us what works so we can shift parallel tasks.
2) Please confirm who on your side owns SOC2/Security evidence delivery (we'll need the SOC2 Type II report + any bridging docs).
3) If procurement requires a PO rather than DocuSign, flag that now so finance can prep.

Notes on sequencing: we propose parallel legal review (MSA + DPA) with an internal Redwood commit to produce consolidated comments within 3 business days after we receive Summit's redlines. That reduces serial churn and keeps the order form negotiation separate but linked (pricing / SLAs).

I've also attached a short set of acceptance criteria for the pilot (attached in MAP_v1). If this sequencing looks good, I'll circulate an updated MAP (v2) after we get Summit's redlines and we'll slot a 30-minute checkpoint on Friday 8/27 to align owners.

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Account Director | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | (415) 555-0129

Alex —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick responses:
- Our legal lead is stretched this week; 8/24 is aggressive. We can commit to returning a prioritized redline set by 2026-08-31. Will mark which items are critical vs. optional in the doc.
- SOC2 evidence: that lives with our InfoSec team. I'll loop in Josh (copied) and request we get you the SOC2 Type II and our encryption whitepaper by 2026-09-02.
- Procurement: we typically require a PO for pilots > $50k, but we can accept DocuSign as an interim signature if finance receives an internal memo. I'll check and confirm by end of day Tuesday.

Two asks from Summit: can Redwood commit to a 7-business-day turnaround for our prioritized redlines (assuming a consolidated set arrives 8/31)? Also, can you add a short contingency plan in the MAP if the DPA needs additional legal time (i.e., pilot can start with an addendum)?

I'll review the attachments and share comments next week. Thanks —

Elena Torres
Sr. Manager, Strategic Sourcing | Summit Health
elena.torres@summithealth.com

Elena / Alex —

Thanks for the note. From a legal/DPA perspective we can support parallel reviews, with the following commitments and clarifications:

1) Turnaround: if Summit provides a prioritized redline set on 2026-08-31, Redwood legal will provide consolidated comments within 7 business days (target 2026-09-09). That aligns to Elena's ask.
2) DPA handling: if the DPA requires additional negotiation beyond the orderform/MSA signature timeline, we propose an "DPA addendum" approach — sign MSA + Order Form to confirm commercial terms and include a binding timeline to finalize DPA (max 30 days post-signature). This allows pilot provisioning to proceed while preserving Summit's data protections.
3) Escalation: we'll route any nonstandard privacy terms to our senior counsel (cc me) and put a 2-business-day SLA on legal triage for items flagged as critical.

I'll update the Draft_MSA_redlines.pdf with a short comment on the DPA-addendum approach and include it in MAP_v2 once Alex requests. Grace / Vanessa — can you confirm operational readiness to provision on 10/05 if we sign no later than 09/20?

Thanks —

We can provision the pilot environment for workload onboarding starting 2026-10-05 provided we have a signed order form and a minimal acceptance checklist 5 business days prior (target 2026-09-25 to hand over to engineering). Monica from Ops (cc) will own the provisioning checklist. A couple of practical items:

- Acceptance criteria: let's confirm the three core testcases (ingest, latency baseline, and key RBAC paths). I'll add those to MAP_v2.
- If the DPA is in final negotiation, we can proceed with a data-limited pilot where Summit's production data is not used until the DPA is finalized. That falls under the DPA addendum approach Karthik suggested.
- If Summit needs a PO ahead of DocuSign, we can accept a PO + internal memo as a runway to start billing; finance will need the PO number by 2026-09-17.
